context: sampling-based approaches do not seem to offer any speedup (if we try to estimate distances by sampling different positions of the pattern string, we would need a sample size of Ω(m), which is not any smaller than the length of the original pattern string). Chan et al. [CGK+ 20] also gave an O(ε−2 n) time randomized algorithm (correct with high probability) without any logarithmic factors, which is preferable when ε−1 is small.
